purpose: Independent practice of D2.1 likelihood scale.
student_learning_goal: I can use all 5 likelihood words on the scale.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use all 5 likelihood words on the scale.
header.character_watermark: Lucky Lou the Loon in the top-right with a clover charm and a 5-word scale chart. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Match each event to one of the 5 likelihood words.
parts.visual_layout: Five labelled likelihood words on the left and five matching event boxes on the right.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 matching layout for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. Left column lists IMPOSSIBLE, UNLIKELY, EQUALLY LIKELY, LIKELY, CERTAIN. Right column has 5 event icons: snow in July, rolling a 6, coin heads, math today, sun rises.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_MATCH at Part 1: keywords name the 5 likelihood words and the matching event icons.

parts.answer_key: snow=impossible, rolling-6=unlikely, coin-heads=equally likely, math=likely, sun=certain.

parts.student_instructions: Place 6 events on the scale strip in the right zone.
parts.visual_layout: A horizontal scale strip with 5 zones (impossible, unlikely, equally likely, likely, certain) and 6 events to place.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 scale strip for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. Horizontal strip divided into 5 zones with labels. Below the strip: 6 event boxes with arrows to the strip.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_SCALE at Part 2: keywords name the scale strip with 5 likelihood zones.

parts.answer_key: Sample placements: 'Tomorrow is Tuesday' = certain, 'Get all 10 dice rolls = 6' = impossible, etc.

parts.student_instructions: Pick ONE event you placed under UNLIKELY. Write WHY it is unlikely.
parts.visual_layout: Lined writing space with a sentence frame for the explanation.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 writing space for likelihood worksheet. Sentence frame at top: 'I think ___ is UNLIKELY because ___.' Below: 4 lines for student writing.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_WHY at Part 3: keywords name the unlikely event writing space.

parts.answer_key: Any valid explanation linking event to unlikely word.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write ONE event for each of the 5 zones.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Diagnostic — check 5-word naming and placement accuracy.
